title: Turn one blog post into a week of social posts
summary: Paste a blog post and get seven platform-native social drafts, each highlighting a different takeaway. You edit for voice, then schedule.

tests.prompt:
Turn this blog post into one week of social posts. Each day should highlight a different point.

Blog post: [PASTE FULL POST OR KEY SECTIONS]
Brand voice: [NOTES]
CTA / URL to include when natural: [URL]
Platforms and constraints:
- LinkedIn: ~150–250 words, professional, 1 CTA
- X / Twitter: ≤260 characters, punchy, no hashtag spam
- Facebook: friendly, 2–4 short paragraphs
- Instagram caption: ≤150 words, line breaks ok, 3–5 relevant hashtags max
- Threads: casual, ≤500 characters

Produce 7 items labeled Day 1–7 with platform + full post text.
Rules: Do not invent quotes, stats, or features not in the post. Vary hooks. No duplicate posts with swapped adjectives.

setup.agent: Any chat model; schedule with your usual social tool afterward
steps: Paste the finished blog post and brand notes into the prompt.
Run it and cut anything that invents claims.
Tune length and hooks per platform.
Schedule across the week in your social tool.
Optional: Make/Zapier to drop approved posts into a queue.
setup.approvalStep: Every post is reviewed before scheduling — especially numbers and product claims.
failureModes: Invented stats not in the article

toolPicks.why: Approved drafts → scheduling sheet or Buffer-like tools you already use.
toolPicks.whenNot: You paste into the native apps.

toolPicks.why: Light queue from Docs to your scheduler.

faq.a: If the post explains terms, yes. If not, add a one-line glossary in the prompt.
Often 20–40 minutes once the post is solid. Longer if you fact-check every claim.
